Title: * 06
Click on the Return Icon to send your entire Troop back to their lair.
~
Button : F_RETCMP
Title: * 06
Right-Clicking on the Lair will also send the selected units home.
~
Title: * 07
Now Click on your new Slave Town.
~
Title: * 08
It costs both Money and Life Points to breed new Fryhtans, which are displayed on the top-right of the screen.  
~
Title: * 08
You receive both when you exterminate living beings, but you will receive most of your Money in tribute from enslaved Towns.
~
Title: * 08
To continue, Click on your Lair.
~
Button : TRAIN
Title: * 09
Before attacking your next Independent Town you will need to Breed more Fryhtans. 
~
Button : TRAIN
Title: * 09
Do this by Clicking on the Breed Icon until the spaces in your Lair are full.
~
Button : TRAIN
Title: * 09
The Breeding of each Fryhtan will be complete when its image is no longer transparent.
~
Button : F_PATROL
Title: * 09
Once the entire Breeding program has been completed, click the Sortie icon to mobilize your troop and enslave the other nearby Independent Town.
~
Title: * 10
Then Right-Click on the Independent Town below your Lair to begin the attack.
~
Title: * 11
Wait for your troops to enslave the Independent Town. You may use the Right square bracket key to increase the game speed and the Left square bracket key to decrease it. 
~
Button : F_RETCMP
Title: * 12
Click on the Return Icon to send your troop back to their lair.
Right-Clicking on the Lair will also send the selected units home.
~
Title: * 13
Now Click on your Lair.
~
Title: * 14
You must now select one of your common 'Crouls' (Fryhtan name for soldiers) to become an 'Ordo' (Fryhtan name for General).
~
Title: * 14
It is best to select the one with the highest level of Leadership, after your 'All High' (Fryhtan name for King).
~
Title: * 14
To see your Leadership levels, Click on the word 'Leadership'.
~
Title: * 14
You will notice that the Croul (soldier) to the right of the All High (king) has the next highest Leadership level.
~
Title: * 14
Right-Click on him to take him out of the Lair.
~
Title: * 15
Now select the Croul (soldier) that you have taken out of the Lair.
~
Button : F_PROMOT
Title: * 16
When you do you will see a new Icon. Clicking on this Star will promote this common Croul (soldier) to Ordo (general). Do this now.
~
Title: * 17
There is an Independent Fryhtan Lair to the right of your base. You can find it by moving the mouse cursor to the right edge of the screen to scroll the map. 
~
Title: * 17
Independent Fryhtan Lairs and Independent human towns are represented by white dots on the mini-map.
~
Title: * 17
Unlike human towns, you cannot bring other Fryhtan Lairs into submission by force. Only gold can tempt them to join you.
~
Title: * 17
If you Click on it you will see nothing. You will be unable to interact with them until you build a new Lair within Linking distance of this Independent Lair.
~
Title: * 18
To build your new Lair, Select your newly promoted Ordo (general). You can do this with the mouse or you can press G on your keyboard.
~
Button : BUILD
Title: * 19
Click on the Build Icon.
~
Title: * 20
Select 'Minotauros Lair' from the Building menu on the right side of the screen and build it next to the Independent Lair that you looked at earlier (to the right of your base). 
~
Title: * 20
When you select a location to build your new lair, make sure that is a visible Linking Line between the building site and the target Independent Lair.
~
Title: * 20
When construction is completed, your Ordo (general) will take his place as commander of the new Lair.
~
Title: * 21
Now click on the target Independent Fryhtan Lair.
~
Button : F_GRANT
Title: * 22
When you do you will see the Payoff Icon.
~
Button : F_GRANT
Title: * 22
Clicking on this will show you how much money it will take to purchase the loyalty of this Lair.
~
Title: * 23
Click on the Yes Button and the Lair will become yours.
~
Button : TRAIN
Title: * 24
You should now Breed a full Troop of Fryhtans in all three of your Lairs. You will need them when you launch your attack on the Human Kingdom that is defiling this world with its presence.
~
Button : F_PATROL
Title: * 24
When your breeding program is complete, Sortie all three of your Troops and attack the Human town located at the south-east of the map (the bottom of the mini-map).
~
Title: * 24
If you find that they are too strong, return to your lairs to heal and build your strength.
~
Title: * 24
A couple things to keep in mind: when an Ordo (general) is slain, you will be unable to Right-Click on a Troop member to select the entire Troop.
~
Title: * 24
If any of your Ordos (general) are slain in battle the Troop that he led will no longer benefit from his leadership skills. You should return the Troop to its Lair and promote another Croul (soldier) to lead it.
~
Title: * 24
Excellent! You have done a great job learning! Now expand your power and annihilate the Human Settlement to the far right of your base. Humans are represented by Green Dots on the mini-map.
~
Title: * 24
You win this tutorial game when you have destroyed ALL the Human Towns and Units. Good luck!
~
Fryhtan Learning Campaign Two

Button : RESEARCH
Title: * 01
Fryhtans, like Humans, may make use of technology.  Unlike Humans, however, Fryhtans need not do research.  
~
Button : RESEARCH
Title: * 01
They instead acquired their technology by a Life Point sacrifice to the spirits of their dead.
~
Button : RESEARCH
Title: * 01
To begin this process, select one of your Lairs and Click on the Research Icon. 
~
Title: * 02
When you do you will see a list of several technologies that you may purchase.  
~
Title: * 02
Some will cost more Life Points than others, depending upon their power.  
~
Title: * 02
Click on the technology that you wish to purchase. You may purchase all of them and then click the Finish/Cancel icon. 
~
Title: * 03
Now that you have paid for a technology, you have the ability to build a Special Fryhtan Structure.  
~
Title: * 03
These structures will be different, with widely differing uses, for every Fryhtan species.
~
Title: * 03
There is no need to link the structures to Towns or other Fryhtan structures.  
~
Title: * 03
They may stand on their own, in any location that you wish to place them.
~
Title: * 03
But they may be built only by a member of the Fryhtan species that has purchased the technology.
~
Title: * 03
Build a Mage Tor now, this being the Special Structure for the Exovum.
~
Title: * 03
This tutorial will proceed when the Mage Tor has been built and is being selected.
~
Title: * 04
Select your Mage Tor and make notice of the Power Bar.  It will slowly build up to full power.  
~
Title: * 04
When the Power Bar has turned blue, the Mage Tor will be ready for use.  
~
Title: * 05
Click on one of the options and then place the shaded white box over a human target at the south-west of the map. Click to activate your Mage Tor.
~
Title: * 05
This action will cost you Life Points and the further away the target is from the Mage Tor, the more Life Points it will cost.
~
Title: * 06
You will find that Mage Tors, like soldiers, are most effective if you have more than one.
~
Title: * 06
Build as many as you can afford and build them as close to potential targets as you think you can get away with.
~
Title: * 06
Your active use of the Mage Tors will be essential in your goal of defeating the Humans of this world.
~
Title: * 06
This Tutorial will be complete once you stand alone over the bodies of your slain enemies.
~Fryhtan Learning Campaign Two

Title: Fryhtan Learning Campaign One **
Your goal in this first Fryhtan learning campaign will to be attack and enslave the world's three independent human towns, to purchase the loyalty of the one independent Fryhtan lair and to completely destroy the world's other Fryhtan Kwyzan.
~
Button: TRAIN
Title: Training (Selecting your first lair) **
Clicking on the Train Icon will initiate the breeding of young Fryhtans. You should breed a full lair.
Breeding will costs both money and life points.
~
Button: TRAIN
Title: Training (Selecting your first lair) **
At the top of your screen you can see your reserves of money, represented by the gold coins and your life points, represented by the green and yellow symbol.
~
Title: Enslavement **
The line linking your lair to the nearby independent town shows that your lair is close enough for you to enslave and exact tribute from the town.  This tribute money will be extremely important in the expansion of your Fryhtan Empire.
~
Title: Enslavement **
Enslavement requires that you attack the town, kill all defenders who come out to meet you, and drive resistance among those cowering at home down to zero.  You will receive life points and money for every person killed.
~
Button: PATROL
Title: Attacking (Selecting your first lair) **
Clicking on the Sortie Icon will take your entire troop out of the lair.  Move them into position with a Right-Click on the ground near the independent town.  When all have arrived, Right-Click on the town to begin the attack.
~
Button: PATROL
Title: Attacking **
Once all defenders have been dispatched and resistance in the town has been driven to zero, send your troop home by Right-Clicking on the lair.
~
Button: PATROL
Title: Attacking **
You may easily select the entire troop by Right-Clicking on any of its members.
~
Title: Slave Towns (Selecting your new slave town) **
You will now see your banner flying over your new slave town.  On the bottom right you will see the amount of tribute collected every year from these slaves.  The amount will depend on the population size and on the leadership of the commander of your lair.  The greater the leader, the greater the tribute.
~
Title: Slave Towns **
If there is no commander (All High or Ordo) in the lair, all tribute from the town will cease.
~
Button: BUILD
Title: New Lairs (Selecting your first lair) **
You should now expand your empire with a new lair.  The best place to build a new lair is within linking distance of one or more independent towns or independent Fryhtan lairs.
~
Button: BUILD
Title: New Lairs (Selecting your first lair) **
To build a lair, take one of your lowest crouls (common soldiers) out of the lair with a Right-Click.  Then select  him and Click on the Build Icon.
~
Button: BUILD
Title: New Lairs **
Place the blue square in the desired area, making sure that there are lines linking the square to the nearby towns or lairs.
~
Title: Ordos (Selecting your first lair) **
You will now want to send your main troop into your new lair, but you should also leave someone in charge of the old so that you can continue the collection tribute money from the slave town.
~
Title: Ordos (Selecting your first lair) **
Clicking on the word Leadership will show the leadership abilities for all of your troops.
~
Title: Ordos (Selecting your first lair) **
Right-Click on the croul with the highest leadership skills, other than your All High (top left).  When the croul exits the lair, select him and Click on the Star Icon to promote him to Ordo (General).
~
Title: Ordos II **
Now sortie your main troop and send it into your new lair with a Right-Click.  Then send your new Ordo into your first lair to assume command.
~
Title: Ordos II (Selecting your first lair) **
Select your first lair, with the new Ordo, and breed a new troop of Fryhtans.  As they train, the leadership level of your Ordo will increase.
~
Title: Taking your Second Town  (Please select your all high's lair) **
Sortie the troop under your All High and attack the linked independent town.  This town will put up more of a fight than the previous one, but you should eventually overcome.
~
Title: Taking your Second Town **
Return your troop to their lair after resistance has been crushed.  Your troops will heal their wounds twice as fast inside their lairs as they will standing in the field.
~
Button: GRANT (Selecting the independent fryhtan lair)
Title: Paying Off an Independent Fryhtan Lair **
You should have built your new lair so that it is linked to an independent Fryhtan lair.  If you did, you will have the opportunity to contact those inside and to offer them money in return for their allegiance
~
Button: GRANT (Selecting the independent fryhtan lair)
Title: Paying Off an Independent Fryhtan Lair **
To do this, click on the Payoff Icon.  You will be told how much money the independent Fryhtans are demanding for their loyalty.  If you find the amount acceptable, click on the OK button and they will join your forces.
~
Title: Endgame **
There is still one human town and one Fryhtan Kwyzan (Kingdom) that have not yet been relieved of their burden of freedom.  To finish this learning campaign you must enslave the human town and destroy the Fryhtan Kwyzan.  You cannot pay these Fryhtans off as you do can the independents.  These you must destroy.

Human Learning Campaign One

Title: * 01
The Linking Line between your Fort and Your town shows that the Fort is close enough to the town so that the Fort's commander can exert his influence over the Town.
~
Title: * 01
When you build new Forts, make sure that they are Linked to Towns.
~
Title: * 01
Your King has a Leadership level of 100, so when he is in the Fort the Loyalty level of the Town will remain high.  When he is removed, the Loyalty level will fall.
~
Title: * 01
Now click on your first Fort and click on the below pointing finger to continue.
~
Button : TRAIN
Title: * 02
Click repeatedly on the Train Icon until your Fort is completely full of trainee soldiers.
~
Title: * 03
Once a trainee has reached the Combat level of 20, the training of the next will begin.
~
Title: * 03
Only when this minimum Combat level of 20 has been reached can your soldier leave the Fort and engage in combat.
~
Title: * 04
While you are waiting for your soldiers to be trained, lets learn something about the interface.
~
Title: * 04
On the top of the screen you can see your Money, Food and Reputation.
~
Title: * 04
Money comes from taxes, trade and loot while food comes from the labor of your peasants.
~
Title: * 04
Reputation is earned by your good (or bad) conduct.
~
Title: * 04
The numbers inside parenthesis show your increase or decrease (red) in the past 12 months.
~
Title: * 05
Leadership is the most important consideration when you are choosing Generals for your army.
~
Title: * 05
You will find that some soldiers have better leadership skills than others.  It is these men that you must watch as future commanders of Troops and Forts.
~
Title: * 06
To see the level of Leadership in your soldiers, Click on the word Leadership when your Fort is selected.
~
Button : PATROL
Title: * 06
Click on the Sortie Icon to mobilize your Troop.
~
Title: * 07
If at any time you wish to select a Troop in the field, simply Right-Click on any of its members.
~
Title: * 08
Your King is easily visible to you in the field by the Crown Icon that he has over his head.
~
Title: * 08
Your enemies will be unable to see this icon just as you will be unable to see theirs.
~
Title: * 08
You may find your King at any time by pressing K on your keyboard.  If he is outside he will be selected.  If he is inside, the building will be selected.
~
Title: * 09
The horizontal bar that you can see over your selected units' heads is their health and power bar.
~
Title: * 09
The length of the bar shows health.  A full bar means 100%.
~
Title: * 09
The color of the bar gives you some idea of the unit's combat skill.  Green units have the weakest combat skill, yellow units have medium skill and purple units are the most skillful.  There are many levels within each color, so just use them as a rough guide.
~
Title: * 10
When you want to withdraw your troop back into your fort, you can simply click the Withdraw icon. Give it a try now. 
~
Title: * 11
If you wish to make another Fort the home Fort for a troop, you must send them into that Fort with a Right-Click.
~
Title: * 12
Independent Towns are easily distinguishable by the absence of a flag. On the small world map you can see them as white squares.
~
Title: * 12
Each nationality has its own architectural style for its Town buildings.  You will soon begin to recognize these, but until you do, Click on the Town to see which nationality lives there.
~
Title: * 12
Click on this Independent Town to proceed.
~
Title: * 13
Every Independent Town will have a level of resistance to your rule.  Some Towns will offer more resistance than others.
~
Title: * 13
They will join your Empire when you have a Fort linked to them and their resistance level has fallen below 30 points.
~
Title: * 13
This level can fall as a result of your King's or General's leadership.  It can also fall when you give the people jobs or when you use violence against them.  But you should note that when you kill civilians your Reputation will suffer.
~
Title: * 14
Now go to your Fort and mobilize one of your soldiers. Then select it. 
~
Button : BUILD
Title: * 15
Click on the 'Build' icon. 
~
Title: * 16
Select 'Fort' from the building menu. Then build a new fort next to the targeted Independent Town. Make sure that there is a Linking Line between the new fort and the town. 
~
Title: * 17
Select your original Fort and mobilize the soldier who has the highest level of Leadership after your King, by right-clicking him.
~
Title: * 17
When he is outside, select him.
~
Button : PROMOTE
Title: * 18
Click on the Promote Icon.
~
Title: * 19
Your soldier is now a General. You can quickly find him by pressing G on your keyboard.
~
Title: * 20
Now select your Fort again and click the Sortie icon to mobilize your King and his Troop and send them to the new Fort so that your he can use his influence to lower the resistance of the Independent Town.
~
Title: * 20
When you have done this, put your new General in charge of your original Fort.  This will keep the Loyalty level of your own Town from falling too much.
~
Title: * 20
You should also Train a new troop of soldiers for him to command.  As you do, his Leadership level will slowly increase.
~
Title: * 20
This tutorial will continue when your King and his troop are garrisoned in the new fort and your General commands a full troop in your original fort.
~
Title: * 21
Click on the Independent Town that you are trying to win over.
~
Title: * 22
When you do, you can see how their resistance is falling.
~
Title: * 22
When it falls below 30 the Town will surrender to you.  It will then have the same status as your original Town.
~
Title: * 22
If you are an impatient player, you may more quickly bring a Town under your thumb by attacking it.
~
Title: * 23
This tutorial will proceed when the town has surrendered.
~
Title: * 24
This is a Fryhtan Lair that is trying to enslave an Independent Town.
~
Title: * 24
It probably does not contain the Fryhtan's strongest troops, so it would make a good first target.
~
Title: * 24
If both of your Forts are filled with fully trained troops, Sortie them now, march to this Fryhtan Lair and destroy it.
~
Title: * 24
The Fryhtan inside may escape, but don't worry.  You will take care of him later.
~
Title: * 24
This tutorial will proceed when you have destroyed the Fryhtan Lair.
~
Title: * 25
There is now one more Fryhtan Lair to destroy, but this one will be more dangerous.
~
Title: * 25
If you do not feel strong enough, you may make another General, build another Fort and train an additional Troop of soldiers.
~
Title: * 25
When you feel yourself strong enough, launch an attack on the remaining Fryhtans.
~
Title: * 25
This first lesson will be complete when you have destroyed them.
Good Luck.
~


Human Learning Campaign Two

Title: * 01
In this Tutorial you will make use of what you learned in the previous one.  
~
Title: * 01
But this time the training and building speeds will be as they are in a normal game.
~
Title: * 01
Your soldiers will also be less powerful, so you will probably need to train more of them than you did previously.
~
Title: * 01
The Fryhtans in this game will start out with a single Lair, but they will be more aggressive and attempt to expand and enslave Independent Towns.
~
Title: * 02
Your goal in this game, as before, is to exterminate every last Fryhtan.
~
Title: * 02
You will find it impossible to do this without the additional Human resources that the world's Independent Towns can provide. 
~
Title: * 02
You must therefore absorb as many of them as you can into your Empire before the Fryhtans can enslave them.
~
Title: * 02
Good hunting!
~
	Human Learning Campaign Two

Title: * 01
In this second Human Tutorial you will learn how to build a thriving economy and how to conduct diplomatic relations with other Kingdoms.
~
Title: * 01
The other Kingdoms in this area are peaceful.  The building of a strong military is therefore unnecessary.
~
Title: * 02
On the small world map, Natural Resource appears as a small black square.
~
Title: * 02
Press 'J' on your keyboard to quickly find and select a deposit of Natural Resource.
~
Title: * 02
Press 'J' again to and cycle through deposits.
~
Button : RECRUIT
Title: * 02
Select your town and click the Recruit icon to take a civilian out of your town. 
~
Button : BUILD
Title: * 02
Now select your civilian unit and click the Build icon and order him to build a Mine on top of the Natural Resource deposit. 
~
Title: * 02
Although the blue square must be placed directly over the resource, it will snap into place so you need not fear that you will misplace it.
~
Title: * 02
The Mine is near enough to be linked to your town.  
~
Title: * 02
This will enable Peasants in your town to become Workers in the Mine.  
~
Title: * 02
They will enter the Mine without any action on your part.
~
Title: * 02
This tutorial will continue when the Mine has been built.
~
Title: * 03
Now that the Mine has been built and raw materials are being extracted, you will need a Factory to churn out finished goods.
~
Title: * 03
Use the same civilian to build a Factory. Make sure that the new Factory is linked to your Mine. 
~
Title: * 03
You must place it so that it is linked both to the Mine and to the Town.
~
Title: * 03
When a Factory is built linked to a Mine, it will be automatically set to produce the correct finished goods to match the raw material.
~
Title: * 03
This tutorial will continue when the Factory has been built.
~
Title: * 04
To sell the goods being produced in your Factory, you will need to build a Market
~
Title: * 04
When building your Market, make sure that it is linked both to your Factory and to your Town.  
~
Title: * 04
It may also be linked to the Mine, although this is not essential.
~
Title: * 04
If your Market is not linked to your Town, the goods will remain unsold.
~
Title: * 04
This tutorial will continue when the Market has been built.
~
Title: * 05
Click on any of your Market to advance to the next section.
~
Title: * 06
With goods in a Market, townspeople will experience a better quality of life.
~
Title: * 06
This will make them more loyal and will encourage the population to grow.
~
Title: * 06
The jobs that you have given to your townspeople in the Mine and Factory will have the same effect.
~
Title: * 07
Selling goods will generate money, but probably not enough to sustain a large kingdom.  
~
Title: * 07
For the necessary added revenue you will have to Tax your people.
~
Title: * 07
To learn how to Tax, Click on your Town.
~
Button : COLLTAX
Title: * 08
You can see the tax button and your Town's Loyalty level. If you Click on the Tax Icon, a Tax will be gathered from all of the people in your Town. 
~
Button : COLLTAX
Title: * 09
If you try this now you will notice that the Loyalty level of the Town decreased by 10 points.
~
Button : COLLTAX
Title: * 09
If you Click repeatedly on the Tax Icon, their Loyalty will fall even faster.
~
Title: * 10
If you Right-Click on the Tax Icon you will see a group of numbered buttons pop up.
~
Title: * 10
Clicking on one of these buttons will set an Automatic Tax that will be collected every time the Loyalty level of your Town reaches this number.
~
Title: * 10
Try Clicking on 90 first.
~
Title: * 10
If you Right-Click on the numbered button instead of Clicking, this Auto-Tax will be set for all of your present and future Towns.
~
Title: * 11
To learn how to Grant, Click on your Town again.
~
Button : GRANT
Title: * 12
You can see the grant button and your Town's Loyalty level. 
~
Button : GRANT
Title: * 13
Grants are the opposite of Taxes; giving money instead of taking it.  
~
Button : GRANT
Title: * 13
You may need to Grant to raise the Loyalty level of a Town, but you will most often Grant to lower Resistance levels in Independent Towns.
~
Button : GRANT
Title: * 13
Grants will increase the Loyalty of a Town by 10 points and decrease Resistance in Independent or enemy Town by 10 points.
~
Button : GRANT
Title: * 13
You may set Auto-Grants in the same way that you set Auto-Taxes.
~
Title: * 14
You can make good money by selling your goods to foreign Kingdoms. To do this you will need a Trade agreement.
~
Title: * 14
Initiate a Trade agreement by Clicking on the Kingdoms Button at the top-left of the screen, or by pressing F1 on your keyboard.  
~
Title: * 14
When you do you will see a menu with a list of the world's kingdoms.  
~
Title: * 15
Click on the kingdom with which you wish to trade, then click on the 'Propose a Trade Treaty' option under 'Diplomacy' submenu.
~
Title: * 16
The message in white text that will appear at the bottom of your screen is the reply to your request.
~
Title: * 16
The colored box in front of the message shows the color of the Kingdom that sent the message.
~
Title: * 16
If this text tells you that your Trade proposal has been accepted, your new Trade partner will send Caravans from his Market to purchase goods from your Market.
~
Title: * 16
Click on any of your Market to advance to the next section.
~
Title: * 17
With your Trade agreement you will be able to send Caravans to the Market of your trading partner to purchase any goods that you cannot produce yourself.
~
Title: * 17
Although you will pay money when you pick these goods up, you will eventually profit when these goods are sold back in your Market.
~
Button : HIRECARA
Title: * 17
To hire a Caravan, select your Market and Click on the Hire Caravan Icon.
~
Title: * 18
To learn how to use Caravan for trading, please select any of your Caravans.
~
Title: * 19
You can see the New Button on the second row of the Caravan's interface.
~
Title: * 19
These rows represent the stops that your Caravan will make. The first row is already set as your home Market.
~
Title: * 20
Click on the New Button on the second row.
~
Title: * 20
After Clicking, you will see that your cursor has changed to a Camel & Arrow.  Click this cursor on a Market of your trading partner.  
~
Title: * 20
If you see that the cursor has a red X over it, it means that you have no Trade treaty with that Kingdom.
~
Title: * 21
To learn more of how to use Caravan for trading, please select any of your Caravans.
~
Title: * 22
Your Caravan began its journey when you Clicked on the foreign Market.  
~
Title: * 22
But you have not yet decided on what it should pick up when it arrives.
~
Title: * 22
The default setting is "Auto", where your Caravan will pick up any surplus goods in the Market.
~
Title: * 23
But you may instead pick up one or more specific goods by Clicking on their image on the shelf.
~
Title: * 23
However, You may NOT drop off any goods at foreign markets.
~
Title: * 24
If you have more than one Town you should make sure that each is linked to a Market.
~
Title: * 24
You may send Caravans between two of your Markets so as to better distribute your goods.
~
Title: * 24
Set these Caravans up in the same way that you did for a foreign Market.  
~
Title: * 24
The difference is that you may drop off goods in your own Markets.
~
Title: * 24
Do this by Clicking on the goods on the top row that you wish to carry to the other Market.
~
Title: * 25
A good way to increase the movement of goods is to have more than one Caravan working the same route.  
~

~
Title: * 26
You can now see the Clone Caravan Icon. Click on it.
~
Title: * 27
When you do, a new Caravan with exactly the same route and loading instructions will be hired and set out on its journey.
~
Title: * 28
You should now have the skills to create a thriving economy and booming population.  
~

Be sure to build Mines on all nearby natural resource deposits and try to have a Factory producing finished goods linked to each.
~
Title: * 28
Be sure that all of your Factories are linked to your Markets so that these goods can be sold.
~
Title: * 28
If this is impossible because of distance, you should know that Factories, Mines and Markets may also be linked by Caravan in the same way that you link your Markets.  
~
Title: * 28

~

You can check the game goals and your scores by pressing the F8 key or by clicking on the 'Rank' button at the top of the screen.

Human Learning Campaign Four

Title: * 01
In this Tutorial you will put to use those lessons learned in the previous Human Tutorial.
~
Title: * 01
Your goal will be to build and Economic Score of 300 and a Population of 200.
~
Title: * 02
The basic things that you should remember to achieve these goals are:
~
Title: * 02
Keep your Markets filled with goods.  Also make sure to evenly distribute your goods among your Markets.
~
Title: * 02
Give your people jobs.  They will be happier, bear more children and buy more goods.  This will help your economy to grow.
~
Title: * 02
Trade with the world's other Kingdoms.
~
Title: * 02
Settle a new Town if the population of a Town approaches its limit of 100.
~
Title: * 02
You always can check the game goals and your scores by pressing the F8 key or by clicking on the 'Rank' button at the top of the screen.	
~
Human Learning Campaign Three

Title: * 01
You should not expect to survive very long should you choose to ignore the benefits of science.
~
Title: * 01
Research brings not only new types of Soldiers and Weapons but also better Combat skills and advanced Production and Farming methods.
~
Title: * 01
To begin your scientific studies you must first build a Tower of Science.
~

As with other buildings that hire workers, now build a Tower of Science within the linking distance of your town.
~
Title: * 02
To learn how to Research, Click on your Tower of Science.
~

To choose the path of your Research, Click on the Research Icon
~

~

~

Once you have completed one level, your scientists will automatically start on the next.
~

~
Title: * 05
For every nationality there is a Special Unit who possesses advanced skills.  
~

~

You will only be able to Research Special Units of a certain nationality if you have a Town of that nationality.
~

~

~

~

Build one of these Special Structures now. 
~

~

To learn how to train Special Units, Click on your Special Structure.
~

~

~

~

~

~

When you do, a downward pointing finger will mark that position. 
~
Title: * 10
You may change the Rally Point by Right-Clicking on another destination.  
~
Title: * 10
Cancel a Rally-Point by Clicking on the No Rally Point Icon.
~
Title: * 11
If you wish to use War Machines against your enemies rather than Soldiers, you will need to research them in your Towers of Science. 
~

There are three levels of research that you can do for each type of War Machine.  
~
Title: * 11
The higher the level, the more dangerous the Weapon.
~

To produce the War Machines you will need to build a War Factory.  
~

Build one now, making sure that it is linked to a Town. 
~
Title: * 12
To learn how to use War Factory, Click on your War Factory.
~

With your War Factory selected, Click on the Build Weapons Icon first.
~

Then Click on the number button above the weapon that you wish to build.

~

~
Title: * 14
You may set Rally Points for your weapons as you did for your Special Units.
~
Title: * 15
Seats of Power are very expensive but also very valuable.  
~

They bring special benefits to your civilization and allow you the opportunity of invoking powerful Greater Beings. 
~

Every nationality will receive a different benefit from its Seat of Power, so you must take these benefits into account as you plan your strategies.
~

~

~

Invoke your Greater Being by selecting your Seat of Power and Clicking on the Invoke Greater Being Icon.  
~
Button : GB-A1

~

~

You may at this time Click on the Special Blessing Icon.

~

~

~

~

~

Change back to your spy's original nation.
~
Title: * 35
One method of getting your Spies into enemy ranks is to make it look as if he has surrendered.

~
Button : SPYNOTI1

Button : SPYNOTI1

~
Button : NOSPY
Title: * 37
If you wish for your Spy to return to normal life, select him and then Click on the No Spy Icon.

Button : NOSPY

He will lay down his cloak and dagger and become a normal soldier or civilian.
~
Title: * 38
This tutorial will continue after you have sent your Civilian Spy into a foreign Town and selected the town. The target town's race must be the same as the spy's. 
~

Once Spies have been infiltrated you should assign them a mission.

~

~
Title: * 41
You have successfully infiltrate your spy into a foreign town. Next, let's target a foreign Fort.

~

This tutorial will proceed after you have trained an Infantry Spy and sent it into a foreign Fort or Camp and selected the building. 
~
Title: * 42

~

If you have a Spy in such a place, find him now and if you don't, infiltrate one.
~
Button : BRIBE

~

~

~
Title: * 43
Select the foreign Fort or Camp with your spy inside.
~
Button : CAPTURE

If you have a Spy who has become an enemy General or if you have successfully bribed an enemy General,

you will have the ability to capture the Fort or Camp that he commands.
~

~
Title: * 45

~
Title: * 46
It is important to remember that the success of your Spies will greatly depend upon their skill level.
~
Title: * 46

~
Title: * 47
Select the foreign Fort or Camp with your spy inside.
~
Title: * 48
Click the Spy Menu Button.
~
Button : ASSASSIN

If you wish to remove a pesky enemy General or King you should consider Assassination.
~
Button : ASSASSIN

~
Button : ASSASSIN

To begin, select the Spy that you wish to use and then Click on the Assassinate Icon.  
~
Button : ASSASSIN

~
Button : ASSASSIN

~
Button : ASSASSIN

If you choose to go ahead, Click one more time on the Assassinate Icon.
~
Button : STEAL_T

Stealing technology can be cheaper and faster than researching it yourself.
~
Button : STEAL_T

~
Button : STEAL_T

Button : STEAL_T

Button : VSECRET

So you can view the same information of other Kingdoms if you have infiltrated a Spy into their midst.
~
Button : VSECRET

To do this, select the location of your Spy, Click on the Spy Eye Icon and then on the View Information Icon.  
~
Button : VSECRET
Title: * 51
When you do you will see a list of the subjects that a Spy of that skill level can view.
~
Button : VSECRET
Title: * 51
Spies with higher skill levels will be able to view more sensitive information.
~
Button : INCIDENT

~Human Learning Campaign Six

Title: * 01
Be sure to build a Mine over the nearby Natural Resource Deposit as soon as you can.  
~
Title: * 01
If you delay, you may find it claimed by another Kingdom!
~
Title: * 02
Remember that your Soldiers will train faster, and fight with more power and skill if they serve under a General (or King) who has a high level of Leadership.
~

~

Make sure that your Markets are linked to both your Factories and to your Towns.

~

~
Title: * 04

~

~
Title: * 04
The higher the Leadership Level, the more the Resistance Level will fall.
~

If you build an Inn you will be able to hire skilled Soldiers or Spies who are of other nationalities than your own.
~

You may also train your own Spies in an Espionage College.  
~
Title: * 05
Putting Civilian Spies in your Towns will help to protect them from Agitation by enemy agents.
~
Title: * 06
Be sure to Trade with as many other Kingdoms as you can.  It will be difficult to become rich if you do not Trade!
~
Title: * 06
Kingdoms with which you have a large volume of  Trade will be less likely to want to fight you.
~
Title: * 07
Mined Natural Resources will eventually be depleted and new deposits will be found.
~
Title: * 07
If you are unlucky with the position of these resources at the beginning of the game, keep a lookout for new deposits at a later date.
